about: Editor spec §42, problem_codes: small notes and the code each problem the drawing reader finds in them carries (packages/core/src/drawing-problem-codes.json, and the graph spec reader's own codes). readers says which readers read the case: core reads it with readNote, and with readBlocks where py reads it too; py reads it with read_for_drawing. Where both read a case, both give the same codes in the same order. Read by packages/core/test/note-reading-codes.test.js and python/graph_spec/tests/test_drawing_problem_codes.py.
